name: english-coach
description: AI Communication Coach - an AI speaking coach for Ethiopian students and professionals

scripts.build: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter server start" "pnpm --filter client start"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && pnpm --filter server db:generate
